# Practice Runtime Repository Rules

## Bootstrap

Before editing, read `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `docs/README.md`, and the relevant sections of `contracts/practice-runtime-v2.md`. Run `./.ai/scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` after policy or contract documentation changes.

## Ownership and invariants

- This service owns Practice V2 TaskInstances, immutable revision and workspace bindings, milestone progress, Submissions, ValidationRuns, official results, human-review receipts, completion, and the Student evidence outbox.
- There is no V2 `Attempt` entity. Do not add one or reinterpret legacy Student attempt rows as V2 state.
- Catalog owns published revisions; Student owns LearningActions, evidence, mastery, and path state; Sandbox owns workspaces and pinned snapshots; Learning Planner owns route receipts; Validation Orchestrator owns execution; Teacher may provide assistance but never decides official results.
- Bind each instance to the exact published revision, runtime profile, and digests returned at Start. Never look up `current` during retries or recoveries, and never infer a missing target or runtime profile from prose.
- Preserve the frozen HTTP fields and lifecycle semantics in `contracts/practice-runtime-v2.md`. A needed wire-contract change is a blocking conflict; do not silently change it.
- Persist idempotency receipts, lifecycle changes, validation records, and outbox events durably. A Submit freezes one exact Sandbox generation; never substitute the live head. Completion and its one evidence-outbox event share a local transaction.
- Keep private evaluation material and raw validator output out of public, Student, Frontend, and Teacher projections.

## Verification and side effects

- Use `.ai/commands.yaml`; safe unit and adapter tests must not start services, migrate a database, or require a test database.
- PostgreSQL integration tests, runtime processes, and migrations require approval as recorded in `.ai/commands.yaml`. Do not apply migrations as part of ordinary tests.
- Preserve reversible versioned migrations and report exactly which checks ran. Do not claim database or cross-service integration verification without running the corresponding approved check.
- Do not put real credentials in code or documentation. Configuration examples use placeholders only.
